context.situation: Original synthetic teaching demonstration: the teacher intentionally offers a stronger completed signal and a weaker incomplete signal.
context.availability: Harbour may choose either Complete or Incomplete. Channel chooses Observe or Distract simultaneously; all listed choices are available.
context.horizon: One scored demonstration only. The later teaching conversation and the learner's understanding are outside this utility model.

utility.meaning: The invented demonstration declares zero-sum transfers of utility credits; Complete always transfers two credits to Harbour, while Incomplete transfers one or zero.
utility.unit: net utility credits to Harbour per demonstration
utility.costs: No action cost or later resource effect is included. This intentionally limited model cannot value the later lesson.
